# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1451
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1451
- **Title**: gh-1449 [GOAL] Orphan-result notices: reported once, never a user turn, always identifies the call
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1449` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 382
- **Additions**: +2233
- **Deletions**: -72
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T13:40:49Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:07:41Z

## PR Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

🚨 **BLOCKING: CI is red on HEAD (`d44b4462`) — `Quality gate` + `CRAP + duplication` failed**

Per `ci_failures.md`, both checks failed on the current HEAD. Local reproduction narrows the cause: with **no CI shard coverage**, every crap4dart gate passes (`analyze`, `check --baseline`, loc, dupx 0.2336% < 0.31%) and all 4 targeted test files pass (250 tests) — so the failing legs are the ones that compute from the **merged test-core lcov**, and the PR ships new branches that nothing in the suite executes:

1. **`_nearestCutBoundary` (`lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart:672-693`, CC ≈ 8)** — only the `compaction summary` arm and the `null` fallback are tested. `branch summary` (:679), `local trim` (:682, only indirectly via `auto_compactor_test`) and `context marker` (:686) are untested anywhere. A partially-covered CC-8 helper is exactly what trips the 12.0 CRAP ratchet.
2. **Host AC6 wiring has zero coverage** — no test anywhere emits a `ToolPairingRepairEvent` with non-empty `notedOrphanKeys` through a host: `lib/src/cli/approval_commands.dart:1079-1083` (persist), `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart:628-634` (seed), and the app twins in `agent_service_events.dart` / `agent_service_sessions.dart`. **ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the multi-orphan note shape escapes the compaction-summary sanitizer (gh-1131 belt)**

For ≥ 2 orphans, `_dropNote` emits a **multi-line** block: opener line + one bullet per orphan + `end context note]` — i.e. **3+ newlines** between `[context note:` and the closing `]`.

The summary sanitizer's whole-block strip (`_stripContextNotes`, `lib/src/compaction/summary_sanitizer.dart:145-157`) only follows a note across **≤ 2 newlines** ("closed by a `]` within the same line or the two lines after it"); anything farther is treated as prose that merely mentions a note and is left verbatim. Fix options: keep the note single-line (join bullets with `; `) for all N, or widen the sanitizer window to the note's max shape (`orphans + 2` lines), and pin the harness's real multi-orphan shape with a `summary_sanitizer_test` case so the two modules can't drift apart again.

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object _) {}),
```

A failed `orphan_report` append here silently breaks the resume contract: the batch is never persisted, and on next open the session re-reports an orphan it "already reported" — with no log line anywhere pointing at the cause. The sibling seed path added in this same PR does log its failure (`AppLog.i('open', 'orphan_report seed failed: $error')` in `agent_service_sessions.dart`), and the repo convention is to log best-effort persist/scan errors, not to drop them. `(Object _)` also discards the error entirely.

Suggest:

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) {
  AppLog.i('persist', 'orphan_report append failed: $e');
}),
```

Minor asymmetry while here: the CLI path routes the record through the redaction pipeline (`_persistToolLivenessRecord` in `agent_cli_persist.dart:186-202`), the app writes the raw data map. Keys are ids so the risk is low, but a one-line comment (or the same pass-through) would keep the two hosts honest.

# pr-1451: gh-1449 [GOAL] Orphan-result notices: reported once, never a user turn, always identifies the call

## Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

## PR Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on

  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block

  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:

  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first

  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap

  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed

- **PR #**: 1451

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1449` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 382
- **Additions**: +2233
- **Deletions**: -72
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T13:40:49Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:07:41Z

## PR Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

# pr-1451: gh-1449 [GOAL] Orphan-result notices: reported once, never a user turn, always identifies the call

## Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1451
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1451
- **Title**: gh-1449 [GOAL] Orphan-result notices: reported once, never a user turn, always identifies the call
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1449` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 382
- **Additions**: +2233
- **Deletions**: -72
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T13:40:49Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:07:41Z

## PR Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

_Previous review discussions for PR #1451._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 9

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: Solid, well-tested implementation of the gh-1449 one-shot orphan notice (993 agent/compaction/session tests pass locally; all library-level ACs are covered), but CI is red on HEAD — `Quality gate` and `CRAP + duplication` failed on `d44b4462` — and the red legs trace to new branches nothing executes: 3 of 4 cut arms in `_nearestCutBoundary` and all host-side AC6 wiring are 0% covered.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 BLOCKING: red CI on HEAD; untested cut arms + untested host persist/seed paths (`comment1`)
- ⚠️ The new multi-orphan note (3+ newlines) escapes the gh-1131 summary-sanitizer's ≤2-newline strip window (`comment2`)
- ⚠️ App persist path swallows write errors silently; CLI seed awaits a whole-file scan on the boot path against the #503 precedent (`comment3`, `comment4`)
- 💡 Latch not cleared across session opens; local-underscore lints; format drift; raw-vs-canonical id in the note (`comment5`–`comment8`)

**Next Steps**:
1. Add table-driven cases for the `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker` cut arms and a host-level resume/persist test for `orphan_report` records; re-run CI until green
2. Log (not swallow) orphan_report persist failures in the app; bound or fire-and-forget the boot-path seed scan
3. Small cleanups: clear the latch on open, rename `_compacted`/`_orphan` locals, `dart format` the app hunk, print the canonical id in the note

---

### Thread 12

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):
# Re: Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

All findings addressed; the PR is test-coverage-complete against the red
legs.

1. **BLOCKING (red CI / 0% branches)** — covered, not redesigned:
   table-driven cases for the three untested `_nearestCutBoundary` arms
   (`branch summary`, `local trim`, `context marker`) + nearest-boundary
   precedence; CLI-level tests for the host AC6 wiring (persist appends the
   `orphan_report` record; resume seeds the latch with no re-note;
   per-session latch); app twins under `flutter test`; per-adapter
   `UT-ROLE` (Anthropic / OpenAI chat completions / Google) pins AC2 on the
   wire. `E2E-LONG` deferred with rationale (thread 1). Local gates green:
   `dart analyze`, `crap4dart analyze` (CRAP ≤ 12), `check --baseline`,
   `loc`; full core suite re-run against the finished tree.
2. **Multi-orphan note vs gh-1131 sanitizer** — note is single-line for any
   N (items `; `-joined), and the REAL production shape is pinned in
   `summary_sanitizer_test.dart` (built via `repairToolPairing`, asserted
   stripped whole) so the two modules cannot drift.
3. **App persist swallow / boot-path scan** — persist failures now log
   (`AppLog.i('persist', …)`); the seed scan is bounded to the primary
   segment (`lastSegmentOnly`, rotation-bounded at 80 MiB) with the
   one-re-report trade documented; scan semantics pinned in
   `read_custom_records_test.dart`.
4. **Suggestions** — latch cleared before seeding in both hosts (RED/GREEN
   regression test included); `_compacted`/`_orphan` renamed;
   `dart format` clean on every touched file; the note prints the
   canonical id.

---


## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

🚨 **BLOCKING: CI is red on HEAD (`d44b4462`) — `Quality gate` + `CRAP + duplication` failed**

Per `ci_failures.md`, both checks failed on the current HEAD. Local reproduction narrows the cause: with **no CI shard coverage**, every crap4dart gate passes (`analyze`, `check --baseline`, loc, dupx 0.2336% < 0.31%) and all 4 targeted test files pass (250 tests) — so the failing legs are the ones that compute from the **merged test-core lcov**, and the PR ships new branches that nothing in the suite executes:

1. **`_nearestCutBoundary` (`lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart:672-693`, CC ≈ 8)** — only the `compaction summary` arm and the `null` fallback are tested. `branch summary` (:679), `local trim` (:682, only indirectly via `auto_compactor_test`) and `context marker` (:686) are untested anywhere. A partially-covered CC-8 helper is exactly what trips the 12.0 CRAP ratchet.
2. **Host AC6 wiring has zero coverage** — no test anywhere emits a `ToolPairingRepairEvent` with non-empty `notedOrphanKeys` through a host: `lib/src/cli/approval_commands.dart:1079-1083` (persist), `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart:628-634` (seed), and the app twins in `agent_service_events.dart` / `agent_service_sessions.dart`. The repo's changed-line coverage ratchet is ≥ 80% (`scripts/diff_coverage.py`); these lines are 0%.
3. Ticket test-plan items not landed: per-provider-adapter `UT-ROLE`, `E2E-LONG`.

**Next steps**: add cheap table-driven cases for the three missing cut arms; add a CLI-level test that (a) resumes a session containing `orphan_report` records and asserts the latch is seeded (no re-note), and (b) emits a repair event with noted keys and asserts the `orphan_report` record is appended; then re-run CI. All 993 `test/agent` + `test/compaction` + `test/session` tests pass locally, so the fix is additive test coverage, not a redesign.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the multi-orphan note shape escapes the compaction-summary sanitizer (gh-1131 belt)**

For ≥ 2 orphans, `_dropNote` emits a **multi-line** block: opener line + one bullet per orphan + `end context note]` — i.e. **3+ newlines** between `[context note:` and the closing `]`.

The summary sanitizer's whole-block strip (`_stripContextNotes`, `lib/src/compaction/summary_sanitizer.dart:145-157`) only follows a note across **≤ 2 newlines** ("closed by a `]` within the same line or the two lines after it"); anything farther is treated as prose that merely mentions a note and is left verbatim. So if the model echoes this PR's own 2+-orphan note into a compaction summary, the stale `[context note: … No reply needed.]` re-renders forever — the exact ephemeral-claim poison class gh-1131/`summary_sanitizer.dart` exists to strip (its docstring even cites the pairing drop note). The single-orphan note stays one line and remains covered.

Fix options: keep the note single-line (join bullets with `; `) for all N, or widen the sanitizer window to the note's max shape (`orphans + 2` lines), and pin the harness's real multi-orphan shape with a `summary_sanitizer_test` case so the two modules can't drift apart again.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: persist failure is swallowed with no diagnostic — an AC6 regression becomes undiagnosable**

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object _) {}),
```

A failed `orphan_report` append here silently breaks the resume contract: the batch is never persisted, and on next open the session re-reports an orphan it "already reported" — with no log line anywhere pointing at the cause. The sibling seed path added in this same PR does log its failure (`AppLog.i('open', 'orphan_report seed failed: $error')` in `agent_service_sessions.dart`), and the repo convention is to log best-effort persist/scan errors, not to drop them. `(Object _)` also discards the error entirely.

Suggest:

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) {
  AppLog.i('persist', 'orphan_report append failed: $e');
}),
```

Minor asymmetry while here: the CLI path routes the record through the redaction pipeline (`_persistToolLivenessRecord` in `agent_cli_persist.dart:186-202`), the app writes the raw data map. Keys are ids so the risk is low, but a one-line comment (or the same pass-through) would keep the two hosts honest.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the latch seed awaits a whole-file raw scan on the resume/boot path**

`repo.readCustomRecordsOfType(metadata, …)` scans **every byte of the full session segment chain** (rotated `.part-NN` segments included) — it must, to find the type strings. Twenty lines below, this same function carries the issue #503 precedent: a comparable whole-file scan measures **~1.5s on a 434 MB marathon** and was made fire-and-forget precisely becau…

# pr-1451: gh-1449 [GOAL] Orphan-result notices: reported once, never a user turn, always identifies the call

## Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1451
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1451
- **Title**: gh-1449 [GOAL] Orphan-result notices: reported once, never a user turn, always identifies the call
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1449` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 382
- **Additions**: +2233
- **Deletions**: -72
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T13:40:49Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:07:41Z

## PR Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the multi-orphan note shape escapes the compaction-summary sanitizer (gh-1131 belt)**

For ≥ 2 orphans, `_dropNote` emits a **multi-line** block: opener line + one bullet per orphan + `end context note]` — i.e. **3+ newlines** between `[context note:` and the closing `]`.

The summary sanitizer's whole-block strip (`_stripContextNotes`, `lib/src/compaction/summary_sanitizer.dart:145-157`) only follows a note across **≤ 2 newlines** ("closed by a `]` within the same line or the two lines after it"); anything farther is treated as prose that merely mentions a note and is left verbatim. So if the model echoes this PR's own 2+-orphan note into a compaction summary, the stale `[context note: … No reply needed.]` re-renders forever — the exact ephemeral-claim poison class gh-1131/`summary_sanitizer.dart` exists to strip (its docstring even cites the pairing drop note). The single-orphan note stays one line and remains covered.

Fix options: keep the note single-line (join bullets with `; `) for all N, or widen the sanitizer window to the note's max shape (`orphans + 2` lines), and pin the harness's real multi-orphan shape with a `summary_sanitizer_test` case so the two modules can't drift apart again.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: persist failure is swallowed with no diagnostic — an AC6 regression becomes undiagnosable**

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object _) {}),
```

A failed `orphan_report` append here silently breaks the resume contract: the batch is never persisted, and on next open the session re-reports an orphan it "already reported" — with no log line anywhere pointing at the cause. The sibling seed path added in this same PR does log its failure (`AppLog.i('open', 'orphan_report seed failed: $error')` in `agent_service_sessions.dart`), and the repo convention is to log best-effort persist/scan errors, not to drop them. `(Object _)` also discards the error entirely.

Suggest:

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) {
  AppLog.i('persist', 'orphan_report append failed: $e');
}),
```

Minor asymmetry while here: the CLI path routes the record through the redaction pipeline (`_persistToolLivenessRecord` in `agent_cli_persist.dart:186-202`), the app writes the raw data map. Keys are ids so the risk is low, but a one-line comment (or the same pass-through) would keep the two hosts honest.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1451
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1451
- **Title**: gh-1449 [GOAL] Orphan-result notices: reported once, never a user turn, always identifies the call
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1449` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 382
- **Additions**: +2233
- **Deletions**: -72
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T13:40:49Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:07:41Z

## PR Description

Closes #1449
### What changed

Orphan-result drop notes (issue gh-1449) are now **one-shot and never a user turn**: the repairer drops the orphan from the payload and reports it exactly once per session, annotating the payload's LAST existing user message with an extra text block instead of appending a new user message at the end (which the model answered, every time). The note names the tool, call id, the cut that removed the call (`compaction summary` / `branch summary` / `local trim` / `context marker`), and a `kept in summary: yes|no` hint, and ends with "No reply needed."

### Key decisions

- One-shot latch = stable key `canonicalToolCallId|tool|timestampMs` (`orphanReportKey`) — ids reset per run, so the timestamp is the position discriminator (E1: same id reused later reports again; the same orphan never does).
- Latch state lives on `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys` (seedable via constructor), threaded through `AgentLoopConfig`; the loop merges `report.notedOrphanKeys` back so retries (incl. the pairing-heal retry) see them.
- AC6 (resume): hosts persist each first-time batch as the hidden `orphan_report` custom record (CLI `_onAgentEvent` + app `AgentServiceEvents`) and seed the latch from a raw record scan at session open (CLI `_loadSession` + app `loadSession`) — helpers `orphanReportRecordData` / `orphanReportKeysFromRecords` shared from `tool_pairing.dart`.
- Transcript stays untouched (payload-only, `UT-TRANSCRIPT`); degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone note (no carrier exists); wire frame gains optional `notedOrphanKeys` (backward-compatible, golden pinned).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart test/compaction/compaction_test.dart test/wire/ test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart
# full gate (verified: 9915 passed, 10 skipped)
dart test --exclude-tags "integration,llm,browser-ext,perf,pty"
```

<details><summary>Coverage map</summary>

- `UT-TEXT`/`UT-ROLE`/`UT-TRANSCRIPT`/`UT-ONESHOT` + E1/E2/E5/REG-PAIRING: `test/agent/tool_pairing_test.dart`
- `IT-ONESHOT` (N requests + pairing-heal retry), `IT-RESUME` (re-seeded agent), AC2 wire-shape: `test/agent/orphan_notice_loop_test.dart`
- Record round-trip through a real JSONL session: `test/session/read_custom_records_test.dart`

</details>

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the multi-orphan note shape escapes the compaction-summary sanitizer (gh-1131 belt)**

For ≥ 2 orphans, `_dropNote` emits a **multi-line** block: opener line + one bullet per orphan + `end context note]` — i.e. **3+ newlines** between `[context note:` and the closing `]`.

The summary sanitizer's whole-block strip (`_stripContextNotes`, `lib/src/compaction/summary_sanitizer.dart:145-157`) only follows a note across **≤ 2 newlines** ("closed by a `]` within the same line or the two lines after it"); anything farther is treated as prose that merely mentions a note and is left verbatim. So if the model echoes this PR's own 2+-orphan note into a compaction summary, the stale `[context note: … No reply needed.]` re-renders forever — the exact ephemeral-claim poison class gh-1131/`summary_sanitizer.dart` exists to strip (its docstring even cites the pairing drop note). The single-orphan note stays one line and remains covered.

Fix options: keep the note single-line (join bullets with `; `) for all N, or widen the sanitizer window to the note's max shape (`orphans + 2` lines), and pin the harness's real multi-orphan shape with a `summary_sanitizer_test` case so the two modules can't drift apart again.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: persist failure is swallowed with no diagnostic — an AC6 regression becomes undiagnosable**

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object _) {}),
```

A failed `orphan_report` append here silently breaks the resume contract: the batch is never persisted, and on next open the session re-reports an orphan it "already reported" — with no log line anywhere pointing at the cause. The sibling seed path added in this same PR does log its failure (`AppLog.i('open', 'orphan_report seed failed: $error')` in `agent_service_sessions.dart`), and the repo convention is to log best-effort persist/scan errors, not to drop them. `(Object _)` also discards the error entirely.

Suggest:

```dart
.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) {
  AppLog.i('persist', 'orphan_report append failed: $e');
}),
```

Minor asymmetry while here: the CLI path routes the record through the redaction pipeline (`_persistToolLivenessRecord` in `agent_cli_persist.dart:186-202`), the app writes the raw data map. Keys are ids so the risk is low, but a one-line comment (or the same pass-through) would keep the two hosts honest.
